description: Stop an offer taking orders: its checkout link (and short cushy link) stops working immediately. Not a delete — the offer keeps its content, stats and order history, and resume_offer re-opens it. Use when the seller says a launch is closed, a promo is over, or something is wrong with what they're selling. Anyone mid-checkout at that moment cannot complete payment, and post-purchase upsells pointing at this offer stop for buyers who just paid. EXISTING SUBSCRIBERS KEEP RENEWING — pausing an offer stops new buyers, not current ones; cancel individual subscriptions with cancel_subscription if that's what the seller means. Requires an admin (or owner) key.
name: pause_offer
title: Pause an offer
